descriptions.zh-Hans: 信使在孟买自制的纸菜单，面包里的土豆团已经摆回正中。
descriptions.en: My homemade Mumbai paper menu puts the fritter back in the middle of the roll.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 我吃过蔬菜咖喱面包后做的菜单，下面还添了一小片纸面包。
descriptions.en: My menu after pav bhaji includes the extra little piece of bread underneath.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 海滨大道歇脚时做的纸签，一端的纸流苏故意剪长了一点。
descriptions.en: My Marine Drive paper tab has one deliberately overlong paper tassel.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 离开科学园后做的小纸座位，两个纸脚都碰得到桌面。
descriptions.en: My little paper seat made after the Science Park has two feet that reach the tabletop.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 我把忘收餐盒的小事做成翻片，掀开纸盒才能看见座面。
descriptions.en: My paper flap records the forgotten lunchbox; lifting it reveals the seat below.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 我在孟买自制的纸卡，两束纸流苏折好后可以并齐。
descriptions.en: My homemade Mumbai card folds two paper tassels into nearly matching ends.
